mechanism: Re-evaluate existing certified single-circle clear D under compact ring + full shared batch; test D and V interaction, keep failed I off.
development: Existing52 x four configs x two rounding modes; no tuned numerical thresholds. Known adverse cases may be reused as development, not unseen.
selection: Complete/audited, lower mean and no higher p95 versus REF in both development models; then lock before new validation. Reject candidates failing this gate; do not weaken it after results.
